scope: A curated starter list of AITU student startups and technology projects, not a complete directory or a claim of commercial availability.
presentation: Localized editorial summaries with local profile pages. Official website brand icons identify FoodSave, Stavleak, Soup and LexiSpark. Omnimammo and CortexAI use original editorial vector marks created for this directory (a pink awareness ribbon and a cyan neural C); they are not verified official project logos. Public website captures are dated; Stavleak demo interfaces are identified as illustrative. Healthcare entries describe research aims, not validated clinical performance. Public team photos are attributed to their publishers. No hiring or investment opportunity is implied.

startups.supports: Student startup in the existing campus directory; surplus-food offers and the public Telegram channel.
startups.editorialNotes: The official site documents Astana food boxes, Telegram ordering and pickup. The Foundation report dated 4 February 2025 lists seven Startup Academy team members and first place; it is presented as a historical roster, not a current founding-team claim. No current prices, partner counts or personal contacts are copied into profile text.

startups.supports: AITU Enactus project presented at the 2026 national competition; AI analysis of images and genetic data for early breast cancer detection.
startups.editorialNotes: The university identifies the project and presenting AITU Enactus team, but not individual founders, a product URL or open roles. Shared event photos are captioned as team photos, not screenshots of medical software.

startups.supports: AITU Enactus clinical decision-support project presented at the 2026 national competition; predicting kidney transplant rejection risk.
startups.editorialNotes: Enactus Global confirms the transplant decision-support focus. The project LinkedIn description also contains older lung-cancer language; the page follows the current university and Enactus announcement and avoids combining conflicting clinical claims or similarly named unrelated companies.

startups.supports: User-requested inclusion in the AITU listing. The official product website describes hackathon discovery and organization in Kazakhstan, including registration, teams, project submissions and judging.
startups.editorialNotes: Official About page verified in Chromium on 29 October 2026: start in 2025; Timur Ryabov (Founder), Maxim Ligay (SMM), Dimash Rakishev (Operational Manager), Sofia Ibragimova (Regional Agent). Public portraits copied from the same page. Contacts page supplies partnerships and support inboxes. Devpost is a portfolio listing, not evidence of a competition win.

startups.supports: Open-source local LLM fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment; layer streaming; Apache-2.0 license; co-founders Alpamys Makazhan (CTO) and Rafik Mamedov (CEO).
startups.editorialNotes: User requested this AITU-connected startup. The founder LinkedIn profile lists AITU education in 2023–2026; the official About page independently confirms his Soup role. Soup CLI is available; Soup Zero is explicitly a concept in development. Do not imply the desktop product is released or repeat hardware benchmarks as independently verified. No personal contacts, speculative founder portraits or job promises are included.

startups.supports: Official website describes language learning from videos and texts, words saved in context with translations, FSRS spaced repetition, browser extension and progress synchronization.
startups.editorialNotes: User requested inclusion and identified the project as belonging to Madi Talgat. That attribution comes from the user, not an independently verified founder biography. No additional role, education, awards or native app availability is claimed.
